items.reason: A gentle cleanser that won't strip skin that already scans low on moisture.
A lower-strength retinol is a more comfortable first step for smoothing the look of fine lines than the 1% serum when you're new to retinoids.
A ceramide moisturizer supports a comfortable skin barrier while you start a night retinoid.
Daily mineral SPF 50 is needed alongside retinol, which makes skin more sun-sensitive.

response.routine_note: Use the retinol at night two nights a week, then build up slowly as your skin is comfortable, and apply sunscreen every morning. I've held back the 1% serum and the retinal eye cream because layering two retinoids from day one tends to irritate, so you could add the eye cream later once your skin has settled.
